Commentary.Commentary: Right then, India Women are the first team to advance to the Semifinals with three Quarterfinals still to take place. With a potential India-Pakistan clash on the cards in the Semifinals, it will be interesting to see which three sides finish in the medal places. That is it then from this game but you can switch tabs and get more information on the upcoming games. Cheers!

Malaysia Women won the toss and elected to bowl which was a brave move and as expected, the Indian openers dominated early proceedings but Malaysia Women did create a few chances that they were not able to take. Interim skipper, Smriti Mandhana did fall trying to accelerate but then came the telling stand between Shafali Verma and Jemimah Rodrigues worth 86 runs and the former was sensational in her knock of 67 runs. Rodrigues too played a fine knock and then Richa Ghosh finished off with a big flourish. For Malaysia Women, Mahirah Izzati Ismail and Ainna Hashim bowled well with the former picking up a wicket as well but unfortunately for them, they only got to bat for a couple of deliveries before the heavens opened up again and they were knocked out of the competition.

UPDATE 9.52 am IST (4.22 am GMT) - The inevitable has happened and the MATCH HAS BEEN ABANDONED! India Women advance to the Semifinals of the Women's Cricket Competition of the Asian Games as they are higher seeded and will now have their eye on sealing a Finals spot.

UPDATE 9.50 am IST (4.20 am GMT) - No update yet from the ground and if the rain persists and it is a washout, India Women will advance to the semifinals by virtue of a higher seeding. Let's stay hopeful that we do see some action. Stick around for more updates.

UPDATE 9.07 am IST (3.37 am GMT) - Oh, no! The rain is back and the covers are coming on once again. The players are back in the hut and it will be another delay, not what anyone would have wanted but it is what it is. Stay tuned for further updates.
